integrity: Proof and executable finite checker are included; conclusions derived from a known skew-zero-forcing duality are identified as corollaries.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers 2<=p<=q only and does not count maximizing sequences or extend to arbitrary line graphs; bibliographic priority and independent mathematical validation remain unresolved. Finite computations are checks, not a universal proof.
title: Grundy total domination of rectangular rook graphs via incidence forests
